However, the baseline pool is read at index [i, j]. At that point i=5, left over from the window loop `for i in range(-5, 6)`, and j=59, left over from the sea-cell loop. So only the single cell at lat index 5, lon index 59 (about 59.16N, 22.44E) supplies baseline values. That one cell sets the threshold for every cell. Every other sea cell's own baseline values do not reach the mask.","cite":["C5:L235-L246","C5:L274-L287","C5:L285","C5:L346"]},"exceptions":{"status":"NONE","items":[]},"summary":"The saved mask is final_mhw_mask (C5:L468). It comes from comparing every region cell's 2005-06-01..08-31 SST against a scalar per-day threshold (C5:L343-L349), followed by grouping runs of 5 or more hot days, with no gap joining (C5:L356-L390). The smoothed thresholds for doy 152-243 draw on raw doys 137-258, i.e. ±5-day pools of May 12-Sep 20 in each year 1992-2002. These pools are read only from the single stale-index cell [5,59] (C5:L285), because the variable i is shadowed by the window loop."}
